plaatsen.tekst: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.
Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many
The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
[[A Psalm of David.]] Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
